description: What World projection 6 emits, as named graphs whose content each SHACL file declares. {archive} stands for the archive identifier, a urn:uuid IRI. ADR 0059 says how this description changes.
default_graph: World puts nothing in the default graph. A query without GRAPH, FROM, or FROM NAMED finds nothing; name the graphs.

graphs.description: Every record revision, its references, and the programs that wrote them.
The projection's version and specification, the core context, and every installed contract bundle.
SKOS concept schemes and concepts that claims point into.
One graph per claim or assessment revision, holding exactly what that revision asserts.
